title: Prepare and finalize REL-v0.7.0 publication

scope.authorization_source: Owner decisions recorded in the 2026-07-28 conversations: promote release traceability as REL-003, freeze four-item scope, declare non-breaking exact-v0.6.0 upgrade compatibility, proceed through current-main pre-tag, create and push the immutable annotated tag, and authorize release closeout after tagging.
out_of_scope: creating, moving, deleting, replacing, or pushing Git tags
mutating the successfully published GitHub Release or its assets
creating or modifying GitHub Issues or Projects
historical archive migration, legacy identifier retirement, STD-001, DEVWF-001, INIT-001, or OBS-001

steps: Register REL-003 and reconcile the exact four-item v0.7.0 backlog set.
Instantiate all six release-publication templates without copying a previous release instance.
Build and validate deterministic candidate packages, exact v0.6.0 upgrade, authored release documents, and the candidate lifecycle contract.
Obtain independent ai-context-auditor candidate verification and close the workflow evidence.
Commit, push, open a ready pull request, pass required checks, and merge through the pull-request-only main policy.
Run the sanctioned current-main pre-tag command and stop before any tag or publication action.
After the owner-created tag and successful hosted publication, validate immutable tag and publication evidence, reconcile registries, and close the workflow.

results.summary: REL-v0.7.0 passed candidate, PR integration, current-main pre-tag, owner-created annotated tag, hosted publication, and registry finalization without moving or recreating the immutable tag.
tests_run: local tag-phase validation passed for annotated tag v0.7.0
hosted publication and finalization validation passed with one stable Release and four governed assets
workflow artifact validation passed for 47 post-adoption workflows and 40 backlog items
AI context version validation passed for 10 release records
release-state tests passed 23/23; backlog release tests passed 6/6; release-note renderer tests passed 6/6
results.residual_risk: No successor release is active; DEVWF-001, INIT-001, STD-001, and OBS-001 remain independently gated.
